title: Building eastern approach base
description: This photo shows the early stages of building the base for attaching the concrete floor platforms to the arches. Spring floods washed out the causeway, and building supplies can be seen stacked at the base of the arches. Construction spanned two years, from 1958 to 1960, continuing through rain, snow, sleet, and sun. (Photo courtesy of Hoot Smith)
